states.name: IDLE
states.description: No automatic batch active. In opeMode=FALSE, manual latches may independently drive actuators. In opeMode=TRUE, no auto actuator is driven.

states.name: FILL_A
states.description: Automatic batch phase; valve A fills until levelSensor >= 50 cm.

states.name: FILL_B
states.description: Automatic batch phase; valve B fills until levelSensor >= 80 cm.

states.name: FILL_C
states.description: Three-material automatic phase; valve C fills until levelSensor >= 100 cm.

states.name: MIX
states.description: Automatic mixing phase; mixing motor runs until mixMotorComplete is TRUE.

states.name: DRAIN
states.description: Automatic drain phase; valve D remains ON until reset, mode change to manual, or a fresh autoStart edge starts a new batch.

transitions.action: Clear all manual latches, abort auto sequence, set phase=IDLE, force all outputs OFF immediately.
Clear all manual latches and auto sequence, set phase=IDLE, suppress all actuator commands this scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(autoStart)
transitions.action: Latch processMode for the active batch; start FILL_A; valve A ON same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND levelSensor >= 50
transitions.action: Close valve A; open valve B same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND levelSensor >= 80 AND processModeLatched = FALSE
transitions.action: Close valve B; start mixing motor same scan. Two-material branch skips valve C.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND levelSensor >= 80 AND processModeLatched = TRUE
transitions.action: Close valve B; open valve C same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND levelSensor >= 100
transitions.action: Close valve C; start mixing motor same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND mixMotorComplete = TRUE
transitions.action: Stop mixing motor; open valve D same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(autoStart)
transitions.action: Start fresh batch; latch processMode; phase=FILL_A; valve A ON same scan.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = TRUE AND modeChange = FALSE AND NOT rising(autoStart)
transitions.action: Hold valve D ON until reset, manual mode switch, or fresh autoStart.

transitions.condition: estop = TRUE AND opeMode = FALSE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(valveAStart)
estop = TRUE AND opeMode = FALSE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(valveBStart)
estop = TRUE AND opeMode = FALSE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(valveCStart)
estop = TRUE AND opeMode = FALSE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(valveDStart)
estop = TRUE AND opeMode = FALSE AND modeChange = FALSE AND rising(mixMotorStart)

state_machine.notes: Exactly one automatic phase transition is evaluated per scan using the pre-scan phase. Manual buttons toggle independent latches only in manual mode with no mode change. estop=FALSE has absolute priority. Edge memories update every scan, including during emergency stop and mode-change reset scans.

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No IEC PT timers are required. Rising edges are detected by one-scan previous-state memories. Edge memories update every scan, including estop=FALSE and modeChange scans, and are not reset by estop or mode change. Therefore a held button cannot retrigger after recovery.

priorities: 1. Emergency stop: estop=FALSE immediately forces valveARun, valveBRun, valveCRun, valveDRun, and mixMotorRun FALSE; clears manual latches; aborts auto phase to IDLE.
2. Mode-change isolation: after the first invocation, a change in opeMode clears manual latches and auto sequence, forces outputs OFF for that scan, while edge memories still update.
3. Automatic sequence: only one auto phase transition per invocation; automatic mode drives at most one actuator at a time.
4. Manual mode: each actuator has an independent rising-edge toggle latch; held/released buttons hold state, and estop/mode change override all latches.
5. Batch behavior: processMode is latched at autoStart for the active batch; DRAIN holds valve D until estop, switch to manual, or a fresh autoStart edge starts a new batch from FILL_A.
scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample all inputs; compute rising edges for valveAStart, valveBStart, valveCStart, valveDStart, mixMotorStart, and autoStart using previous-state memories; compute modeChange = initialized AND (opeMode <> prevOpeMode); first invocation has modeChange=FALSE; update previous-state memories including edge memories even if estop=FALSE or modeChange=TRUE.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: first apply estop=FALSE reset; else apply modeChange reset/suppression; else if opeMode=TRUE evaluate exactly one automatic phase transition using pre-scan phase and latched processMode; else if opeMode=FALSE apply independent manual toggle latches on rising edges; update phase and latch/sequence state for same-scan output effect.
3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer function blocks are required; this stage remains an explicit no-op every scan.

4. Unified output assignments: if estop=FALSE then all actuator outputs FALSE; else if modeChange=TRUE then all actuator outputs FALSE; else if opeMode=TRUE then drive the single actuator selected by phase (FILL_A=valveA, FILL_B=valveB, FILL_C=valveC, MIX=mixMotor, DRAIN=valveD, IDLE=none); else drive each actuator from its independent manual latch.
